That's all very well if you are retired, you have all day everyday to make calls if you want! Some of us do work for a living.

He explained all this while on the phone,  but no the receptionist said you can only make appointments on line, she said there are plenty available but you must book online, what is up with people today! I thought doctor's surgeries where meant to help people. An appointment could have been made there and then easy! But no, why is it so difficult, it should not be this hard.
